title: Grading report
description: The contract between a grader and the backend. Written to report.json and uploaded as the `grade-report` artifact; the backend reads it with its own App token, which is why the graded job needs no outbound credential.

passed.description: Authoritative pass/fail. ExerciseScore.isPassing derives from this.

tests.description: Per-test results. Drives the UI checklist and leaves room for partial credit later; ExerciseScore is binary today.
